newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Kinkel condemns Tel Aviv bombing. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel condemns Tel Aviv bombing. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: German Foreign (Corrects from Finance) Minister Klaus Kinkel on Friday sharply condemned the bombing of a Tel Aviv cafe which killed at least four people.

Kinkel sent a telegram of condolence to his Israeli counterpart David Levi saying the attack, which he said was intended to harm the Middle East peace process, filled him with "disgust and indignation".
